visualCharacteristics.purpose: Statistic tiles: icon, large stat value and short description

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: icon image (or :icon:); cell 2: bold paragraph with the stat value (or a heading), then a description paragraph
contentPattern.sourceDescription: Six stat tiles: icon, stat value (+1 Billion, 40-70%, +200, <0.5 ratio, 5%, 2.9 x), description

usage: Obesity statistics section on the home page.
reuseGuidance: Use for any set of numeric highlights. Stat values are bold text, not headings, to keep heading hierarchy valid.
